title: Black Bean & Lentil Chilli with Crispy Corn
style: Hearty, smoky plant-based chilli with protein-rich beans and lentils
description: Deeply satisfying black bean and lentil chilli finished with smoky spices, lime, and crunchy roasted corn.
steps: Cook the Chilli: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook for about 10 minutes until very soft and lightly golden.
Add garlic, cumin, smoked paprika, oregano, and chilli powder. Cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato purée and chopped tomatoes. Add black beans, red lentils, and vegetable stock. Bring to a simmer.
Cook uncovered for 30–35 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick, rich, and the lentils are tender. Mash some of the beans against the side of the pot for extra body.
Season aggressively with salt and finish with lime juice.
Crispy Corn: Heat oven to 220°C / 425°F. Toss dried sweetcorn with oil, smoked paprika, and salt. Spread on a baking tray.
Roast for about 25 minutes, shaking once or twice, until golden, crisp, and popping.
tips: Mash some beans for thickness and leave others whole for texture.
Don’t skip the smoked paprika — it’s key to depth.
Finish with lime for balance; it makes the chilli feel complete.
